blocks.text: The perfect balcony by DUMSKAYA DESIGN

parts.html: When a designer takes on the job, even a small balcony becomes a cozy place for relaxing and socializing all year round. And in our case, that’s a full 8 square meters of relaxation.
Lounge area: A large, comfortable corner sofa with soft cushions and throws runs along the walls.
Bar counter: A wood-and-metal bar counter with high stools runs along the glazing. It’s the perfect spot for morning coffee or an evening cocktail with a view of the city.

Storage: A spacious cabinet appears to be built into the wall — an optical trick. It has plenty of room for seasonal items, cushions, throws, and tools, while its understated design keeps the space uncluttered.
Barbecue: A compact yet functional barbecue area. The grill stands on its own base, which is both safe and convenient.
UFO heater: It lets you use the balcony all year round: even in the colder months it stays warm and cozy — perfect for family evenings and get-togethers with friends.

Greenery and decor: Potted plants and greenery climbing along the beams add freshness and a natural, cozy feel. In the evening, soft light from floor lamps and recessed fixtures creates a romantic atmosphere.
The result: The balcony has become the true gem of the apartment — a stylish, functional place for relaxing and socializing.
Want to transform your balcony the same way? Contact DUMSKAYA DESIGN — we’ll help make it stylish and comfortable.
